title: Making games
summary: I started by making games (Haxe, HaxeFlixel, Heaps, C#, Godot). I still do: Minnen, a psychological game about night terrors, is in development.

title: Rendering roots, performance discipline
summary: Games led me into graphics and engine work professionally, where performance is non‑negotiable. That’s where I learned to profile, measure, and ship changes you can actually feel, not just benchmark.

title: Full-stack delivery with guardrails
summary: I moved into product delivery: admin tools, APIs, database work, and CI so releases stayed routine instead of stressful.

title: Regulated systems and AI-assisted tooling
summary: Today I work in regulated systems, where clarity matters. I lean on good logging, good tests, reproducible runs, and tooling that helps teams move quickly without guessing.
